services.title: Our Services
services.subtitle: Everything you need to buy property in Turkey
services.realty_desc: We offer comprehensive services to find the most suitable apartment from our partner housing projects. We've personally inspected every project.
services.consulting_desc: Make the right decision with our expert team covering the legal, financial, and tax aspects of real estate investments in Turkey.
services.citizenship_desc: We provide full legal support and process management for Turkish citizenship applications through real estate investment of $400,000 and above.
services.transfer_desc: From your arrival in Istanbul to property handover — VIP transfer, hotel reservations and interpretation services throughout your stay.
services.legal_desc: Our experienced legal team handles contract review, title deed registration, notary approvals, and tax number registration.
services.translation_desc: Professional interpretation and official document preparation services in Uzbek, Russian, Turkish, and English.

why.title: Why Altis Global?
why.subtitle: Trust, transparency and continuous support
why.r1_desc: We've personally visited and inspected all projects. Zero risk of misinformation.
why.r2_desc: No hidden fees. Commission information is clarified from the start.
why.r3_desc: We stay by your side after receiving your title deed — occupancy permit, rental management and citizenship process.
why.r4_desc: Our expert team speaks Turkish, Uzbek, Russian and English — answering your questions instantly.

process.title: How We Work
process.subtitle: Your property ownership journey in 4 steps
process.step1_desc: Contact us via WhatsApp or phone. Let's determine your budget, preferences and investment goals together.
process.step2_desc: We present projects suited to your needs. We share video tours, virtual visits and detailed information.
process.step3_desc: VIP transfer welcome upon your arrival in Istanbul. Visit projects in person and reserve the apartment you like.
process.step4_desc: Purchase agreement, payment plan, title deed transfer, and citizenship application if desired — we're with you at every step.

about.title: About Us
about.subtitle: Your trusted partner
about.text1: At Altis Global, we provide comprehensive guidance to citizens of Central Asian Turkish Republics — especially investors from Uzbekistan — in purchasing property in Turkey.
about.text2: Our expert team, serving from our office in Başakşehir, was established to eliminate the difficulties foreign buyers face due to language barriers, legal uncertainty, and cultural differences.
about.text3: We don't just sell homes. We connect you with the right project, and stay by your side from travel and accommodation arrangements to title deed delivery and citizenship application.
